name: ApprovalDelegationPlanner
tagline: The Approval Delegation Planner lets an approver plan who approves on their behalf, for which approval types, from when to when and up to what amount - for annual leave…
description: The Approval Delegation Planner lets an approver plan who approves on their behalf, for which approval types, from when to when and up to what amount - for annual leave, business travel, training or busy periods. Everything is shown on a timeline (one row per delegate) or as cards, and the planner checks your organisation's rules as you type.
features: Timeline and list views, status filters with counts (active, scheduled, expired, cancelled, overlaps), search and sorting
Summary tiles: active now, scheduled, next handover and overlaps
A form with quick date ranges and a live count of calendar and working days
Rules: maximum length, a limit that can never exceed your own authority, a reason for the audit trail, no back-dated start, and overlapping delegations blocked, warned about or allowed
Extend 7 days, End today, Cancel, Repeat and Delete - each with Undo
A phone layout designed for small screens
